Transcripts of ALL college degrees/coursework needed to qualify for this position; unofficial or legible copies are acceptable but must indicate that the degree(s) has been conferred, if applicable.

01. Do you possess a Masters degree in counseling, rehabilitation counseling, clinical psychology, counseling psychology, guidance counseling, educational counseling, social work, career development, marriage and family therapy or marriage, family and child counseling, Options: Yes | No

02. Do you possess a bachelor's degree in counseling, rehabilitation counseling, clinical psychology, counseling psychology, guidance counseling, educational counseling, social work, career development, marriage and family therapy or marriage, family AND child counseling and a license as a Marriage and Family Therapist (MFT). Options: Yes | No

03. If you do not possess the minimum qualifications as specifically stated in the job announcement, are you submitting an application for equivalency? Options: Yes | No | I meet the minimum qualifications as stated.

Possession of a Master’s degree in counseling, rehabilitation counseling, clinical psychology, counseling psychology, guidance counseling, educational counseling, social work, career development, marriage and family therapy or marriage, family and child counseling OR

Possession of a bachelor's degree in one of the fields above and a license as a Marriage and Family Therapist (MFT) as applicable under California Community Colleges minimum qualification standards OR
Provide individual and group counseling to students regarding academic, career, transfer, and personal or student-success concerns.

Counsel students regarding degree, certificate, transfer, general education, and graduation requirements and assist in identifying education and career goals; develop comprehensive student educational plans.
Assist students in understanding academic policies, procedures, program requirements, course selection, prerequisites, and academic progress.
Provide transfer counseling and information regarding transfer requirements, articulation agreements, and university opportunities.
Connect students with appropriate campus programs, student services, community resources, and other support services.
Maintain appropriate and accurate counseling records and documentation in accordance with District procedures and applicable confidentiality requirements.
Participate in outreach, workshops, orientations, transfer activities, registration activities, and other student-support programs as assigned.
Participate in department meetings, professional development, and other activities appropriate to the part-time faculty assignment.
Comply with District policies and procedures, applicable collective bargaining agreements, accreditation standards, and federal and state laws and regulations.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
the Equivalent
If needed to meet the minimum qualifications, a copy (front and back) of your fully satisfied, lifetime California Community College credential authorizing service in the appropriate discipline.
Understanding of, sensitivity to and respect for the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability and ethnic backgrounds of Peralta Colleges’ students, faculty, staff and community.
